findings.message: closed-schema census: 2 schemas declare `additionalProperties: false`, which the generated code does not enforce — an undeclared field in a request payload is silently dropped, not rejected. Enforcement lives in serializer configuration the generator does not emit. UpdateCustomer, UpdateOrder.
findings.suggestedFix: Either accept that the constraint is documentation-only, or configure your JSON stack to reject unknown members (Newtonsoft: MissingMemberHandling.Error; System.Text.Json: JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow).

findings.message: Optimistic-concurrency precondition census: 2 operation(s) declare a required If-Match or a 412 response, 2 of them get a generated gate, 0 of them delegate their guarantee to another aggregate root (CONCURRENCY_PRECONDITION_DELEGATED, reported separately and not counted as gated), 0 do not. The gated half counts both call sites since FEAT-2026-0107: the generated domain-service write, and the delegated operation wrapped by {Tag}ApplicationServiceBase. A delegated operation whose token no read publishes is counted as NOT gated — the wrapper exists, but no client can satisfy it.
x-entity.delete census: soft 0 / hard 0 / undeclared 4 (of 4 x-entity schemas).
x-entity.concurrency census: optimistic 2 / none 2 / delegated 0 / undeclared 0 (of 4 x-entity schemas). 2 unprotected: 1 single-writer, 1 reference-data.

ETag declaration census: 2 operation(s) declare an ETag response header, 0 of them on a single-instance response resolving to an entity that does not declare x-entity.concurrency: optimistic (ENTITY_TAG_DECLARED_UNGATED), 0 of them on a collection response (ENTITY_TAG_DECLARED_COLLECTION), and 0 gated entity(ies)' safe read declares no ETag at all (ENTITY_TAG_UNDECLARED_GATED). The three populations converge independently on distinct spec edits, so gate 2's severity flip reads this line, not a warning count.
428 declaration census: 0 operation(s) declare a '428' response the generator never emits (PRECONDITION_REQUIRED_DECLARED_UNEMITTED).
soft-parent/hard-child edge census: 0 owning edges where a soft-delete parent owns a hard-delete child (belongsTo/x-fk-for only, x-references excluded).
